items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: But later on I found out, she was a trumpet player herself, and the wife of Smitty -- Russell Smith.

ctx.x: I said who is this big wench to go and tell me how good I'll be some day, and I just played the man's music. Who is she? You know, I didn't know who she was. But later on I found out, she was a trumpet player herself, and the wife of Smitty -- Russell Smith.
